title: KILL CHAIN TICKS CLIMB A NOTE FOR EACH KILL
why: His yes on pick 72. Each kill that chains inside the 4 second streak plays a small soft sine tick one pentatonic note higher than the last (E5 up to A6, the key of the medal pops), and a broken chain starts again from the bottom note. No words, on the sting bus, much quieter than a medal pop.
now: Chained kills now tick a note higher each time, and a broken chain starts the climb again.
